comments.body_html: Don’t know if this is just a me issue or a mod issue, but when playing with fika I have sat through a hour of waiting for it to load the bundle

comments.author: hengfu
comments.body_html:
Currently, due to certain special reasons, Fika cannot retrieve non-standard Unity resources files (i.e. files without .bundle extension, even though they are identical except for the extension…). The solution is to manually retrieve the cache.

Find the Mod that has custom resources that you need to load.

Open the corresponding Mod folder, and find the bundles folder located under the Mod directory.

Select all the files in the bundles folder, copy them, and paste them into the user/cache/bundles directory.

comments.author: hengfu
comments.body_html: This is the solution I can find right now.
